ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 60% high-intensity white and 40% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white lateral fields; dense black contiguous pigmentation concentrated around the median notch and fluke base, with distinct diagonal black bands extending across the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of ~0.3.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge; extreme distal tips exhibit high-frequency, high-amplitude peaks (jagged texture), while the medial edges show lower-frequency variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Geometric convexity along the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering to acute angles at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark, circular pixel clusters concentrated heavily at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, corresponding to sites of previous colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct black arc-shaped marks on the left lobe's white field; multiple unaligned diagonal linear streaks on the right lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Rough, irregular trailing edge profile with significant material loss/jaggedness at the distal tips; visible dark scarring at the lateral extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive occlusion of the fluke-peduncle insertion point by high-intensity white water spray and splash pixels.
